museum-storm-bringer.summary: Bring healing for sustained runs; destroy turrets and handle interruption checks. Cover or other protection may still be needed.
museum-storm-bringer.cover_policy: Selective cover for dangerous attacks; continuous firing is not guaranteed by healer presence.
museum-storm-bringer.healing_reason: Repeated incoming damage makes a sustained run difficult without healing.
museum-storm-bringer.confidence: Guide-based composition rule; healing sufficiency unverified

museum-ultra.summary: Shockwaves and poison need protection; repeated cover use can exhaust cover HP.
museum-ultra.cover_policy: Shield or selective cover; a cover-repair unit can help longer runs.

anomaly-ultra.summary: Use shielding for shockwaves. Cover poison attacks unless a sufficiently strong shield can absorb them.
anomaly-ultra.cover_policy: Selective cover for poison and dangerous attacks; healing cannot undo a lethal hit.
anomaly-ultra.confidence: Guide-based shield preference enforced; shield strength and uptime unverified

anomaly-kraken.summary: Destroy front tentacles before their charged attack, which ignores cover and shields. The separate team-wide attack can be covered or shielded.
anomaly-kraken.cover_policy: Cover cannot replace the tentacle damage check. Use protection selectively for the other attacks.
anomaly-kraken.confidence: Part-destruction and protection rules; deadlines unverified

anomaly-harvester.summary: Clear dangerous adds and destroy the head to expose the core. Leaving too many adds alive causes heavy team damage.
anomaly-harvester.cover_policy: Cover or taunt targeted gunfire as needed; prevent add pressure through damage.
anomaly-harvester.confidence: Guide-based add-clear preference; wave and survival simulation incomplete

anomaly-indivilia.summary: Handle suicide adds and destroy the tail before its lethal attack. Frequent lasers require protection.
anomaly-indivilia.cover_policy: Selective cover for lasers; phase-transition attacks need specific protection. No cover glitch is assumed.
anomaly-indivilia.confidence: Guide-based priorities; precise phase-transition survival unverified

anomaly-mirror-container.summary: Bring a strong single shot for Glass Slippers and a precise aiming option for red/grey circles. More total DPS does not establish either check.
anomaly-mirror-container.cover_policy: Hold other shooters while setting up the slipper shot. Cover, shield or taunt targeted attacks when needed.
anomaly-mirror-container.confidence: Weapon-access checks only; one-shot threshold and player aim unverified
